checks.intent: string and number checks (min/max/regex/trim/toLowerCase/email/int/positive/refine) must not change the stored validator

containers.intent: arrays (strings, objects with optional id), nested objects, union, discriminated union field, string-keyed records

defaults.intent: defaults on scalar, enum, array and nested object field, default().optional(), optional().default(); defaulted fields in command and public masks

ids.intent: zid fields: required, optional, array of ids, nullable id

indexed.intent: zodTable with chained index, searchIndex and vectorIndex on .table

masks.intent: serverFields, commandFields and publicFields including timestamp fields

modifiers.intent: optional, nullable, optional().nullable(), nullable().optional(), nullish, optional object and array

noOptions.intent: zodTable with no options: empty command and public masks

scalars.intent: zodTable scalars: string, number, int (two spellings), boolean, null, literals, enum of one and many values, bigint

shared.intent: createTable shared fields merged ahead of table fields

strictness.intent: z.object, z.strictObject, z.looseObject and catchall nested fields

tenantIndexed.intent: tenantTable with an index over the injected tenant field

tenantPublic.intent: tenantTable exposing tenant and archivedAt publicly with an extra server field

transforms.intent: transform, pipe and coerce: input and output converters diverge

variantBoundary.intent: zodVariantTable boundary mode, timestamps omitted, three branches with per-branch masks

variantLegacyDiscriminated.intent: zodVariantTable legacy mode (no options) over a strict discriminated union

variantLegacyUnion.intent: zodVariantTable legacy mode over a plain z.union of non-strict objects with a default

variantNoTimestamps.intent: zodVariantTable boundary mode with timestamps: false, branch declares its own createdAt

variantTimestamps.intent: zodVariantTable boundary mode with timestamps: true, timestamp public fields and an index
